instruction:
Design the database schema for the e-commerce shopping mall platform with the following key requirements:

## Customer Account
- Registration required for all features (no guest browsing)
- Email and password authentication
- Account deletion preserves orders and reviews

## Seller Account
- Separate seller registration with admin approval
- Seller account deletion restrictions based on pending orders

## Snapshot Principle
- All data modifications create immutable snapshots
- Snapshots for products, variants, seller profiles, order items, reviews, cancellation/refund requests

## Product Structure
- Products with variants (SKU system)
- Inventory management with history records
- Product images with ordering

## Order Management
- Orders with items from multiple sellers
- Shipment tracking system
- Order item status management

## Review System
- Reviews for delivered products only
- Rating and text content

## Administrator System
- Two-tier admin system (regular and super)
- Seller approval and management
- Category management

## Key Relationships
- Customers ↔ Orders ↔ Order Items ↔ Products ↔ Sellers
- Products ↔ Variants ↔ Inventory History
- Snapshots for all critical data modifications

models.name: ecommerce_mall_customers
models.description:
Customer accounts with email/password authentication credentials and profile information for registered buyers.

Stores authentication credentials for customer login including email address and password hash. Contains profile information such as display name and phone number for customer identification and communication. Supports soft deletion where account deletion preserves historical order and review data while preventing new authentication.

The table maintains temporal tracking with created_at, updated_at, and deleted_at fields to support audit trails and account lifecycle management. Foreign key relationships establish connections to customer sessions, password reset workflows, and email verification processes.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer's email address used for authentication, communication, and account recovery. Must be unique across customer accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password credential for customer authentication. Never stores plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Customer's public display name shown in reviews, order communications, and social features.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Customer's phone number for delivery coordination and account verification purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was first created during registration.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account information was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was soft deleted, preserving historical data.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for customer authentication with access and refresh token support and session management.

Tracks customer login sessions with connection context information including IP address, connection URL, and referrer for security auditing. Each session is associated with a specific customer account and includes expiration timestamps for secure session management.

Sessions are managed through authentication workflows rather than direct CRUD operations, providing an append-only audit trail of customer login events. The session table supports JWT token management and secure authentication mechanisms for the e-commerce platform.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Associated customer's {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the customer's connection for security auditing and geographic tracking.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL where the session was established for context tracking.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating where the customer came from before login.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created for login event tracking.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires for secure session management. Sessions must have expiration for security compliance.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens with expiration for secure customer password recovery workflow.

Manages one-time use tokens for customer password reset requests with built-in security constraints including expiration timestamps and usage status tracking. Each token is cryptographically secure and expires automatically to prevent unauthorized access.

Tokens are generated when customers initiate password reset requests and must be used within the validity period. The system tracks token usage to prevent replay attacks and ensure each token can only be used once for security purposes.

This table implements core authentication security protocols as referenced by the customer's {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id} identity record. Soft deletion support maintains audit trails while allowing token cleanup after usage or expiration.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer requesting password reset. References the customer's {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: token_hash
plainFields.description: Cryptographic hash of the password reset token for security. Stored as hash to prevent token exposure even if database is compromised.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp after which the token becomes invalid for security protection.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was successfully used to reset the password. Null indicates unused token.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created and token generated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset record was last updated, typically when token is used.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for audit trail maintenance. Null indicates active record.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for customer registration confirmation with expiration timestamps.

This table manages the email verification workflow for customer accounts, storing unique verification tokens that are sent to customers during registration. Each token has a limited validity period and is automatically invalidated once used or expired.

The verification process ensures customer email validity and prevents fraudulent account creation. Tokens are generated during registration and verified when customers click the confirmation link in their email.

The table maintains audit trails of verification attempts and supports security best practices through expiration enforcement and one-time use validation. Failed verification attempts are tracked for security monitoring and spam prevention.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer account needing email verification. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token sent to the customer's email address for confirmation.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp after which the verification token becomes invalid for security.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer successfully verified their email address using this token.

plainFields.name: verification_attempts
plainFields.description: Count of verification attempts made with this token for security monitoring.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token was generated and sent to the customer.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification record was last updated, including verification attempts.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sellers
models.description: Seller accounts with email/password authentication credentials and shop profile information requiring admin approval. Sellers must undergo approval process before they can list products and manage their shops on the platform. Each seller has business profile details and administrative status tracking for platform compliance.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller's email address used for authentication and business communication. Must be unique across all sellers on the platform.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication. Stores bcrypt hash with salt for protection of seller account credentials.

plainFields.name: business_name
plainFields.description: Legal business name of the seller used for official registration and customer-facing display.

plainFields.name: contact_phone
plainFields.description: Business phone number for official communication and customer support contact.

plainFields.name: business_address
plainFields.description: Physical business address for verification and official correspondence. Supports international address formats.

plainFields.name: tax_id
plainFields.description: Business tax identification number for regulatory compliance and financial reporting.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Seller profile description explaining business focus, specialties, and customer value proposition.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Seller account status: pending_approval, approved, suspended, rejected. Controls platform access and business operations.

plainFields.name: approved_by
plainFields.description: Administrator who approved the seller registration. References administrator's {@link ecommerce_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: approved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller was approved by an administrator for platform access.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by administrator when rejecting a seller application. Guides seller on improvements for reapplication.

plainFields.name: suspension_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for account suspension when seller violates platform policies or fails compliance requirements.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of seller's last successful login for security monitoring and account activity tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was initially created and registration submitted.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last modification to seller account information. Updated on profile changes and status updates.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp indicating when the seller account was marked for deletion while preserving business records.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
Seller login session records for authentication and connection tracking.

Tracks seller login sessions with connection context including IP address, URL, and referrer information for security auditing. Each session has a creation timestamp and expiration time to manage session lifecycle.

Sessions are managed through authentication workflows rather than direct CRUD operations. The table maintains an audit trail of seller login activity for security monitoring and compliance requirements.

Multiple concurrent sessions are supported per seller to accommodate different devices and browser sessions.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged seller's {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the connection where the session was created for security auditing.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL where the session was initiated for context tracking.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating the page that directed the seller to the login page.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp recording when the seller authenticated.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp when the session becomes invalid for security.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_password_resets
models.description:
Stores temporary password reset tokens for seller accounts with secure token hashing and expiration tracking.

Each record represents a password reset request initiated by a seller that needs to be completed within the expiration period. The token is securely hashed and uniquely generated for each reset attempt to prevent unauthorized password changes.

The table maintains audit trail information including creation timestamps and supports soft deletion to preserve security audit history while allowing cleanup of expired tokens. All password reset operations are tracked against the seller's active sessions to maintain security compliance.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Target seller account requiring password reset. {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: token_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password reset token used for authentication during password recovery process. Should be generated uniquely for each reset attempt.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset token expires and becomes invalid. Password recovery must be completed before this time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created and the token was generated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset record was last updated, typically when the reset is completed or expired.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset record was soft deleted, allowing cleanup while maintaining audit trail integrity.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for seller registration confirmation with expiration timestamps.

Stores verification tokens sent to seller email addresses during the registration process. Each token is associated with a specific seller account and must be verified within the expiration period to activate the seller's account.

Tokens follow security best practices with limited validity periods and one-time use constraints. Once verified, the token is marked as used and cannot be reused. Supports the seller registration approval workflow by ensuring email address authenticity.

Implements the snapshot architecture principle through immutable verification records that maintain the verification history for audit purposes even after account deletion considerations.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller account requiring email verification. {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token string sent to the seller's email address. Generated as a cryptographically secure random string.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification token expires and becomes invalid. Tokens typically have short validity periods for security.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller successfully verified their email address using this token. Null until verification occurs.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification token was created and sent to the seller.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification token record was last updated, typically upon verification.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_administrators
models.description:
Administrator accounts with email/password authentication for platform management and oversight.

Stores credential information for administrator users who manage platform operations including seller approvals, category management, and user oversight. Administrators have elevated permissions compared to regular customers and sellers but fewer privileges than super administrators.

Required to have verified email addresses and secure password authentication following platform security standards. Supports account suspension/reactivation and maintains audit trails of administrative actions through created timestamps and soft deletion tracking.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Administrator's login email address used for authentication and platform communications. Must be unique across all administrator accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for administrator authentication using platform-approved cryptographic algorithms.

plainFields.name: password_salt
plainFields.description: Cryptographic salt used in password hashing to ensure password secrecy and security.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Administrator account status controlling login capability and platform access. Possible values: 'active', 'suspended', 'pending_verification'.

plainFields.name: first_name
plainFields.description: Administrator's first name for identification and communication purposes.

plainFields.name: last_name
plainFields.description: Administrator's last name for identification and communication purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was created for audit trail purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was last updated for change tracking.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was soft deleted, allowing recovery and preserving audit trails of terminated accounts.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_administrator_sessions
models.description:
Administrator login session records for authentication and connection tracking.

Stores JWT session tokens and connection context for authenticated administrator access.
Captures IP address, connection URLs, and session expiration for security auditing.
Maintains one-to-many relationship with administrators for active session management.

**Security Notes:** Sessions must expire for security compliance. Expired_at is mandatory and server-side enforced.
Used for authentication workflows, not directly managed through administrator CRUD operations.

foreignFields.name: administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticated administrator's {@link ecommerce_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the connection that created this session for security auditing.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full connection URL including path and query parameters for session context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from HTTP headers indicating previous page navigation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created during administrator login.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session should expire for security compliance. Must be non-null for security enforcement.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_administrator_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens with expiration for secure administrator password recovery workflow.

Stores unique tokens generated when administrators request password resets. Each token is associated with a specific administrator account and has a limited validity period for security. Tokens are single-use and automatically expire after a set duration to prevent unauthorized access.

The table maintains an audit trail of password reset requests while ensuring security through token expiration and administrator association. Failed attempts or expired tokens are tracked through the expiration mechanism rather than deletion to maintain security audit capabilities.

Password reset tokens are managed through the administrator authentication system and are not directly accessible to users for independent management.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator account requesting password reset. {@link ecommerce_mall_administrators.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token generated for administrator authentication. Used to verify password reset requests and ensure single-use security.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was created. Used for token expiration calculation and audit trail.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token expires. Tokens become invalid after this time for security purposes.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was successfully used. Null indicates the token is still valid and unused.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_administrator_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for administrator account verification process with secure token generation and expiration management.

Stores verification tokens sent via email to administrators for account activation and email confirmation. Each token is uniquely generated and linked to a specific administrator account. Includes expiration timestamps to enforce security by automatically invalidating tokens after a defined period.

Tokens are managed through administrator authentication flows and are automatically cleared after successful verification or expiration. This table supports the security requirements for administrator account verification and email confirmation workflows specified in the authentication documentation.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the administrator account awaiting email verification via this token. {@link ecommerce_mall_administrators.id}

plainFields.name: token

models.name: ecommerce_mall_super_administrators
models.description:
Super administrator accounts with highest privileges for administrator management and platform oversight.

Represents the highest level of administrative authority in the e-commerce platform, capable of managing other administrators, configuring system-wide settings, and overseeing all platform operations. These accounts require email and password authentication and maintain comprehensive audit trails for security and compliance.

Super administrators have elevated permissions beyond regular administrators, including the ability to promote/demote other administrators, access sensitive system logs, and override certain business rules. Account deletion follows platform security protocols while preserving necessary audit trails.

Stores login session data for super administrators, including connection context for security auditing. Each session is associated with exactly one super administrator and tracks authentication events with timestamps and connection metadata for audit trails.

Sessions record IP addresses, connection URLs, and referrer information for security monitoring. The expired_at field enforces session expiration for security compliance, preventing indefinite session persistence unless explicitly configured as nullable for special cases.

The composite index on super_administrator_id and created_at supports efficient session lookup and cleanup operations. Sessions follow the established authentication pattern used across all actor types in the platform.

Supports flexible category management operations including creation, renaming, reorganization, and soft deletion while preserving category-product relationships.

The hierarchical structure enables flexible product discovery paths while maintaining category integrity through parent-child relationships. Categories can be toggled between active and inactive states to control product visibility while preserving historical category assignments.

Seller relationship ensures proper ownership tracking and access control for product management. Products are designed to support the snapshot architecture by capturing modifications through the separate product snapshots table for historical data preservation.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_product_categories
models.description:
Junction table linking products to categories for flexible product organization and filtering.

Enables many-to-many relationships between products and categories, allowing products to be assigned to multiple categories and categories to contain multiple products. This provides flexible product organization and supports advanced filtering capabilities across the product catalog.

The table maintains referential integrity between products and categories while supporting the hierarchical category structure defined in the Systematic component. Each relationship includes creation and modification timestamps for audit trail purposes.

Products can be dynamically re-categorized without affecting their core product information, and categories can be reorganized while maintaining existing product assignments.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product's {@link ecommerce_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged category's {@link ecommerce_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product-category relationship was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product-category relationship was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product-category relationship was soft deleted.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variant_options
models.description:
Individual option values assigned to product variants for proper normalization and advanced filtering.

Each record represents a single option-value pair for a specific product variant, decomposing the JSON structure into relational format. This enables efficient querying by individual option values and supports advanced product filtering capabilities.

The table maintains referential integrity with product variants and supports the business requirement for sophisticated product discovery and filtering based on specific attributes.

Option values are stored as discrete fields rather than JSON arrays, ensuring proper database normalization and enabling efficient indexing for search operations.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product variant's {@link ecommerce_mall_product_variants.id} that this option value belongs to.

plainFields.name: option_name
plainFields.description: Name of the product option (e.g., "size", "color", "material").

plainFields.name: option_value
plainFields.description: Specific value for this option (e.g., "XL", "Red", "Cotton").

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this option value was assigned to the variant.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sales
models.description:
Main sales listings combining product information, seller details, pricing, and availability status.

Represents individual sales offerings by sellers within the e-commerce platform. Each sale listing contains product details copied from the source product at listing time, seller information for ownership tracking, pricing configuration, and status management for platform visibility.

Sales maintain references to their source product, seller owner, and category classification. The table supports rich product displays while allowing seller-specific pricing and promotion overrides. Status fields control visibility and manage platform approval workflows for new listings.

Sales integrate with the snapshot system through the associated ecommerce_mall_sale_snapshots table to preserve historical states when sellers modify their listings. Soft deletion allows for listing removal while maintaining data integrity for past orders and reviews.

The pricing structure includes both base selling price and optional promotional pricing, enabling sellers to run targeted discounts and campaigns without permanently altering their base pricing strategy.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who created and owns this sale listing. {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Source product providing base product information for this sale. {@link ecommerce_mall_products.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Primary category classification for this sale listing. {@link ecommerce_mall_categories.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Display title for the sale listing. Should be descriptive and search-friendly to help customers find the product.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the sale listing including product features, specifications, and seller-specific information.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base selling price for standard sales without promotions. Serves as reference for calculating discounts and promotional pricing.

plainFields.name: sale_price
plainFields.description: Current active sale price if promotional pricing is applied. If null, base_price is used for transactions.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the sale listing controlling platform visibility. Valid values: active, inactive, pending_approval, rejected.

plainFields.name: is_available
plainFields.description: Availability flag indicating whether the sale listing is currently available for purchase. Allows temporary disabling without deleting.

plainFields.name: requires_approval
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this sale requires administrator approval before becoming active on the platform.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the sale listing was originally created by the seller.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the sale listing was last modified by the seller or system.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the sale listing was soft deleted. Null indicates active listing.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable snapshots preserving complete sale state including variants and images for audit trail.

Captures the entire state of a sale listing at the moment of any modification, ensuring data integrity for dispute resolution and historical tracking. Each snapshot represents a point-in-time copy of the sale's complete information including active prices, promotions, variant configurations, and associated images.

The snapshot system enables accurate historical analysis and provides precise documentation of what customers saw during their purchase decision process. Snapshots are automatically created when sales are modified and cannot be altered once created, serving as definitive evidence in case of disputes about pricing, product descriptions, or availability claims.

All snapshots reference their original sale entity via sale_id, allowing comprehensive audit trails of how sales evolve over time while maintaining referential integrity with other business entities in the system.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the original sale entity whose state is being snapshotted. {@link ecommerce_mall_sales.id}

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Sale name as it appeared at the time of snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Complete sale description including all formatting and content at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base price of the sale before any promotions or discounts were applied.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Sale status (active, inactive, draft, archived) at the moment of snapshot.

plainFields.name: seller_id
plainFields.description: Seller ID responsible for the sale, captured for historical reference.

plainFields.name: category_id
plainFields.description: Category assignment of the sale at snapshot creation time.

plainFields.name: variants_data
plainFields.description: JSON representation of all sale variants including SKUs, options, and variant-specific pricing at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: images_data
plainFields.description: JSON representation of sale images including URLs, ordering, and metadata captured at snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: promotions_data
plainFields.description: JSON snapshot of active promotions and discounts applied to the sale at the time of snapshot capture.

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: Complete sale metadata including tags, custom fields, and classification data preserved for historical accuracy.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was automatically created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot record was last updated (should match created_at for immutable snapshots).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for snapshot management while preserving audit trail integrity.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_variants
models.description:
Specific variants available within sales with SKU codes, option values, and pricing details.

Each sale variant represents a unique combination of options and pricing for products listed in sales. Variants include SKU codes for inventory tracking, option values for customer selection, and pricing details specific to the sale context.

Sale variants maintain their own stock levels independent of the main product inventory, allowing sellers to offer limited quantities at sale prices. Variants can be activated or deactivated based on availability and sale duration.

The relationship with the parent sale ensures proper catalog organization, while the optional reference to product variants allows for consistency with the main product catalog when applicable.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged sale's {@link ecommerce_mall_sales.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to product variant's {@link ecommerce_mall_product_variants.id} for consistency with product catalog.

plainFields.name: sku
plainFields.description: Stock Keeping Unit code for inventory tracking and variant identification. Must be unique within the sale context.

plainFields.name: option_values
plainFields.description: JSON string containing variant option combinations and values for customer selection.

plainFields.name: sale_price
plainFields.description: Special sale price for this variant during the sale period.

plainFields.name: original_price
plainFields.description: Original price before sale discount for comparison purposes.

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Available quantity of this variant for sale. Separate from main product inventory.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Variant status: active, inactive, sold_out, or discontinued. Controls visibility and availability.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the sale variant was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the sale variant was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the sale variant was soft deleted.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_prices
models.description:
Pricing history and current pricing information for sales including promotional discounts and validity periods.

Tracks both current and historical pricing for sales entities, supporting base prices, sale prices, promotional discounts, and effective date ranges. Maintains complete pricing audit trail for compliance and historical analysis.

Each pricing entry can be tied to either a specific sale (for sale-wide pricing) or a sale variant (for variant-specific pricing). The status field distinguishes active pricing from historical records, while effective date ranges ensure proper pricing application during validity periods.

Pricing entries include base price (regular price), sale price (current promotional price), discount percentage, and currency information. The pricing source field tracks whether pricing is system-generated, manually set, or promotional in origin.

Maintains relationships with {@link ecommerce_mall_sales.id} for sale-wide pricing and optionally with {@link ecommerce_mall_sale_variants.id} for variant-specific pricing.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the sale this pricing belongs to. {@link ecommerce_mall_sales.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to specific sale variant for variant-level pricing. {@link ecommerce_mall_sale_variants.id}

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base or regular price before any discounts or promotions. Represents the standard selling price.

plainFields.name: sale_price
plainFields.description: Current selling price including any active discounts or promotions. This is the price customers pay.

plainFields.name: discount_percentage
plainFields.description: Discount percentage applied to create the sale price from base price. Null if no discount active.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Currency code for the pricing (e.g., USD, EUR, KRW). Ensures consistent currency handling across the platform.

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description: Start date and time when this pricing becomes active. Used for scheduled pricing changes.

plainFields.name: effective_to
plainFields.description: End date and time when this pricing expires. Null for ongoing/persistent pricing.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Pricing status indicating whether this pricing is active, expired, or scheduled. Controls pricing activation.

plainFields.name: pricing_source
plainFields.description: Source of this pricing entry: system-generated, manual-entry, promotional, or automated.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this pricing entry was created. Used for audit trail and chronological ordering.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this pricing entry was last updated. Tracks modifications to pricing data.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_promotions
models.description:
Active promotions and discount campaigns applied to sales with validity periods and conditions.

Stores promotional campaigns that offer discounts or special offers on sales listings. Each promotion specifies discount amounts, validity periods, and applicable conditions for targeted sales. Promotions can be created by sellers or administrators and may target specific sales or apply across multiple eligible sales based on conditions.

Includes comprehensive promotion details such as discount type (percentage, fixed amount, buy-one-get-one), minimum purchase requirements, customer eligibility rules, and promotional messaging. Supports time-limited campaigns with precise start and end dates for automated activation and expiration.

Maintains audit trail for promotion lifecycle management and supports promotion performance tracking when combined with order data. Follows the platform's snapshot architecture principle where modifications create immutable snapshots for historical preservation.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who created and manages this promotion.{@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_id
foreignFields.description: Specific sale targeted by this promotion, if promotion is sale-specific.{@link ecommerce_mall_sales.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Promotion title displayed to customers for marketing and identification purposes.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed promotion description explaining discount terms, conditions, and promotional messaging.

plainFields.name: discount_type
plainFields.description: Type of discount applied (percentage, fixed_amount, bogo_free, bogo_discount). Percentage discounts apply as percentage of sale price, fixed_amount reduces by specific amount.

plainFields.name: discount_amount
plainFields.description: Amount of discount based on discount_type. For percentage discounts, value should be between 0 and 100.

plainFields.name: minimum_purchase_amount
plainFields.description: Minimum cart or purchase amount required to qualify for this promotion, null means no minimum.

plainFields.name: maximum_discount_amount
plainFields.description: Maximum discount amount that can be applied for percentage discounts, prevents excessive discounts on high-value items.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Date and time when promotion becomes active and applicable to eligible sales.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Date and time when promotion expires and becomes inactive.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this promotion is currently active and should be displayed/applied to eligible sales.

plainFields.name: usage_limit
plainFields.description: Maximum number of times this promotion can be used across all customers, null means unlimited usage.

plainFields.name: customer_usage_limit
plainFields.description: Maximum number of times a single customer can use this promotion, null means unlimited per customer.

plainFields.name: promo_code
plainFields.description: Optional promotional code that customers must enter to apply this promotion, enables targeted marketing campaigns.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this promotion was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this promotion was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this promotion was soft deleted, null if active.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_images
models.description:
Multiple images associated with sales for product display and marketing purposes.

Stores image metadata including URLs, descriptions, ordering sequence, and display properties for sales listings. Each image is associated with a specific sale and supports the visual presentation of products in the sales catalog.

Images are managed through sale operations and follow the snapshot architecture for audit trail purposes. The ordering field determines the display sequence of images for each sale, allowing sellers to prioritize product visuals effectively.

Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit trails while allowing content moderation and image replacement workflows.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged sale's {@link ecommerce_mall_sales.id}.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: URL of the image file stored in the image service.

plainFields.name: ordering
plainFields.description: Display sequence order for images within the sale. Lower numbers appear first.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description or caption for the image.

plainFields.name: is_primary
plainFields.description: Whether this image is the primary/default image for the sale.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was added to the sale.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image metadata was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was soft-deleted, or null if active.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_reviews
models.description:
Customer reviews and ratings for sales listings with purchase verification and content management.

Stores feedback from customers who have purchased and received sales items. Each review captures the customer's experience through a 5-star rating system and optional text content. Reviews require purchase verification to ensure only legitimate customers can provide feedback.

The system maintains comprehensive audit trails including delivery confirmation tracking and review modification histories. Reviews support moderation workflows with reporting capabilities and status management to ensure content quality and platform integrity.

Reviews are linked to both the customer who created them and the sale being reviewed, enabling comprehensive reputation tracking and customer sentiment analysis across the marketplace. Soft deletion is supported for content moderation while preserving audit trails.

foreignFields.name: sale_id
foreignFields.description: The sale being reviewed. {@link ecommerce_mall_sales.id}

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who created the review. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: The order item that establishes purchase eligibility. {@link ecommerce_mall_order_items.id}

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: The 1-5 star rating assigned by the customer. Valid values: 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest).

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Optional review title summarizing the customer experience.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Optional detailed review content describing the customer's experience with the sale.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Review status for moderation workflows. Valid values: pending, approved, rejected, flagged.

plainFields.name: verified_purchase
plainFields.description: Flag indicating the review is from a verified purchase. Set to true after delivery confirmation.

plainFields.name: delivery_confirmed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the item delivery was confirmed, establishing review eligibility.

plainFields.name: helpful_count
plainFields.description: Count of other customers who found this review helpful.

plainFields.name: report_count
plainFields.description: Count of times this review has been reported for moderation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was initially created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was soft deleted for moderation.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_questions
models.description:
Customer questions about products listed for sale in the sales catalog.

Stores inquiries from customers seeking additional information about sale listings before making purchase decisions. Each question is associated with a specific sale and created by an authenticated customer through their active session.

Questions remain attached to the sale even if the product details change, providing historical context for customer inquiries. Customers can ask multiple questions per sale listing, and each question can receive one answer from the seller.

The question content includes title and body fields for structured inquiry formatting. Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit trails while allowing content moderation for inappropriate questions.

This entity enables customer-seller communication and helps provide transparency about sale listings through community Q&A functionality.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_id
foreignFields.description: Associated sale listing being questioned. References sale's {@link ecommerce_mall_sales.id} that the customer is inquiring about.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Question creator's identification. References customer {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id} who asked the question through their active session.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_session_id
foreignFields.description: Active session during question creation. References session {@link ecommerce_mall_customer_sessions.id} used for authentication when asking the question.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Brief summary title of the customer's question about the sale listing. Provides a quick overview of the inquiry topic and helps sellers understand the question scope at a glance.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Detailed content of the customer's question explaining their specific inquiry about the sale listing. Contains the full question text with any clarifying details or specific points the customer seeks information about.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer submitted the question about the sale listing. Records the exact time of question creation for audit trail and customer service reference.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to the question. Updated when the question content is edited by the customer providing a complete modification history.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the question was soft deleted for content moderation or customer request. Allows question removal while preserving audit trail and historical context.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_question_answers
models.description:
Seller responses to customer questions about sales listings, maintaining proper normalization with separate entity structure.

Each answer is created by an authenticated seller in response to a specific customer question about a sales listing. The separate table structure avoids the normalization violations of combining question and answer data in a single table with nullable answer fields.

Answers maintain independent lifecycle management from questions, supporting search across seller responses, moderation workflows, and seller accountability tracking. The 1:1 relationship is enforced via unique constraint to ensure each question receives at most one answer from sellers.

This approach follows the snapshot-based architecture principle by preserving seller session context and timestamps for audit trail integrity. When a seller answers a question, their response is permanently linked to their seller account and active session for accountability.

Customers can view seller answers to make informed purchasing decisions, while platform administrators can monitor answer quality and timeliness as part of seller performance evaluation. Answers remain visible even if the seller later terminates their account or modifies their profile information.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_question_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer question being answered by this response. {@link ecommerce_mall_sale_questions.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller providing this answer to the customer question. {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_session_id
foreignFields.description: Active seller session context when creating this answer. {@link ecommerce_mall_seller_sessions.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Answer title summarizing the seller's response to facilitate customer browsing and quick reference.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Detailed answer content providing seller expertise and information to address the customer's question.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller created this answer to track responsiveness metrics.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller last modified this answer to track content accuracy maintenance.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for answer moderation and archival preservation requirements.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_categories
models.description:
Junction table establishing many-to-many relationships between sales and categories for catalog organization.

Each record represents a category assignment for a specific sale, allowing sales to appear in multiple categories while maintaining proper catalog structure. This enables flexible product categorization where a single sale can be listed in relevant categories to improve discoverability.

The table supports the snapshot architecture by maintaining assignment history and enabling audit trails for category modifications. Category assignments can be independently tracked for each sale, allowing sellers to optimize product visibility across different category sections.

Soft deletion is supported to preserve assignment history while allowing category reorganization without losing audit trails.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_id
foreignFields.description: Associated sale listing being categorized. {@link ecommerce_mall_sales.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Category that the sale belongs to. {@link ecommerce_mall_categories.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category assignment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category assignment was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category assignment was soft deleted for audit preservation.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_favorites
models.description:
Customer favorites and wishlist entries for tracking customer interest in specific sales.

This table manages the many-to-many relationship between customers and sales items they have marked as favorites. Each record represents a customer's interest in a particular sale, which can be used for personalized recommendations, wishlist functionality, and customer behavior analysis.

Customers can independently add and remove sales from their favorites list. The system tracks when items were added and modified, supporting features like 'recently favorited' and providing insights into customer preferences over time.

Favorites are customer-specific and private by default, allowing personal collection management without public visibility. This supports wishlist functionality where customers can save sales for future purchase consideration.

The implementation includes soft deletion support to maintain historical tracking while allowing customers to clean up their favorites list as needed.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who added this sale to their favorites. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: sale_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the sale that has been marked as favorite by the customer. {@link ecommerce_mall_sales.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer added this sale to their favorites list.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this favorite entry was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this favorite was removed from the customer's list, supporting soft deletion.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_view_stats
models.description:
Tracks individual viewing events and analytics data for sales performance monitoring.

Captures granular view details including customer associations, device information, viewing duration, and referral sources for comprehensive sales analytics. Each record represents a distinct viewing session that contributes to overall view counts and performance metrics.

When customers are authenticated, their viewing activity is linked to their account for personalized analytics. Anonymous views are tracked separately with session-based identification. View statistics support business intelligence reporting and sales performance optimization through detailed engagement metrics.

Viewing data is used to calculate conversion rates, identify popular sales, and optimize marketing strategies based on customer engagement patterns recorded through detailed analytics tracking.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the viewed sale's {@link ecommerce_mall_sales.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the viewing customer's {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id} when authenticated.

plainFields.name: viewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the viewing session began for chronological tracking and reporting.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address of the viewer for geographic analysis and security monitoring.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: Client browser or device user agent string for device type identification.

plainFields.name: referrer_url
plainFields.description: URL of the referring page that directed the visitor to the sale page.

plainFields.name: duration_seconds
plainFields.description: Length of time the sale was viewed in seconds for engagement analysis.

plainFields.name: view_source
plainFields.description: Source identifier for the view event (search, direct, social, email, etc.).

plainFields.name: device_type
plainFields.description: Device category for analytics (mobile, tablet, desktop, etc.).

plainFields.name: country_code
plainFields.description: Country code derived from IP address for geographic segmentation.

plainFields.name: session_id
plainFields.description: Unique session identifier for tracking multiple views within same browsing session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for audit trail and data processing.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp for data maintenance tracking.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_specifications
models.description:
Detailed technical specifications and attributes for sales listings.

Stores comprehensive product specifications including features, dimensions, technical details, and attributes that customers need to make informed purchase decisions. Each specification set belongs to exactly one sale listing and provides detailed product information beyond basic descriptions.

Specifications include measurements, materials, technical specifications, features, and other attribute data that helps customers understand the product's capabilities and limitations. The specifications are managed independently from the main sale information to allow detailed technical data organization.

Specification data supports advanced filtering, comparison features, and detailed product information displays. Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit trails while allowing content updates.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the main sale listing that these specifications belong to. {@link ecommerce_mall_sales.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title or name of the specification set, providing a descriptive label for the technical details.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Overall description of the specifications, providing context for the technical details contained within.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Category or classification of the specifications (e.g., technical, dimensions, features, materials).

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Priority level for display ordering, with higher numbers indicating more important specifications.

plainFields.name: is_visible
plainFields.description: Whether these specifications should be displayed to customers or kept for internal reference only.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the specification set was initially created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the specification set was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the specification set was soft deleted, or null if currently active.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_specification_attributes
models.description:
Individual attribute entries within sale specifications.

Stores specific attribute-value pairs that make up the detailed specifications for sales. Each attribute represents a single piece of technical information such as a dimension measurement, feature description, or technical specification.

This child table enforces First Normal Form by decomposing repeating attribute groups that would otherwise violate normalization principles if stored as arrays or JSON objects in the parent table. Each attribute is stored as a separate record with its own name, value, and metadata.

Attributes support various data types through standardized value representation and include ordering information for proper display sequencing. The table maintains referential integrity with the parent specifications table.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_specification_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent specification set that this attribute belongs to. {@link ecommerce_mall_sale_specifications.id}

plainFields.name: attribute_name
plainFields.description: Name or label of the attribute (e.g., 'Weight', 'Dimensions', 'Material', 'Processor').

plainFields.name: attribute_value
plainFields.description: Value of the attribute, which may represent measurements, descriptions, or specifications.

plainFields.name: value_type
plainFields.description: Type of the attribute value (e.g., 'number', 'text', 'boolean', 'measurement').

plainFields.name: unit
plainFields.description: Unit of measurement for numeric attributes (e.g., 'kg', 'cm', 'GHz').

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Order in which this attribute should be displayed within the specification set.

plainFields.name: is_important
plainFields.description: Whether this attribute is considered important and should be highlighted in displays.

plainFields.name: created_at

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_availabilities
models.description:
Tracks sale availability status including active/inactive periods, stock status, and listing visibility.

This table manages the lifecycle and availability state of sales listings, ensuring proper visibility and stock management. It records active periods when the sale is available for purchase, tracks current stock status, and controls listing visibility for customer-facing display.

Each availability record is tied to a specific sale and maintains temporal boundaries for when the sale is active. Stock status updates trigger availability changes, and listing visibility controls allow sellers to temporarily hide sales without removing them from the system.

The table supports business rules around sale activation, inventory management, and customer-facing availability while maintaining audit trails for availability changes.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_id

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_metadata
models.description:
Extended metadata and attributes for sales listings including classification data, custom field definitions, and organizational tags.

This table serves as the central repository for additional metadata associated with sales listings beyond the core product information. It supports flexible classification systems, custom field definitions for seller-specific attributes, and organizational tagging for improved search and filtering capabilities.

Each metadata record is directly associated with a specific sale listing and provides extensible attribute storage that maintains data integrity while allowing sellers to customize their listing information.

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_metadatum_tags
models.description:
Individual tags associated with sale metadata for improved categorization and search functionality.

This child table decomposes the repeating group of tags that would otherwise violate First Normal Form (1NF) if stored in the main metadata table. Each tag represents a specific categorization label that can be applied to sales listings for organizational purposes.

Tags support flexible categorization systems and enable advanced filtering and search capabilities across the sales catalog.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_metadata_id

plainFields.name: tag_name

plainFields.name: tag_category
plainFields.description: Optional category grouping for tags to organize them hierarchically.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the tag was added to the metadata.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_metadatum_fields
models.description:
Custom field values associated with sale metadata for extended attribute storage.

This child table decomposes the repeating group of custom fields that would violate First Normal Form (1NF) if stored directly in the main metadata table. It provides flexible storage for seller-defined attributes and custom field values that extend beyond the standard sale information.

Custom fields support seller-specific requirements and enable specialized attribute tracking for different types of sales listings.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_metadata_id
foreignFields.description: Parent metadata record for this custom field. {@link ecommerce_mall_sale_metadata.id}.

plainFields.name: field_name

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_performance_metrics
models.description:
Performance tracking and analytics metrics for sales including conversion rates, revenue calculations, and engagement analytics.

Tracks key performance indicators for sales listings to measure effectiveness and customer engagement. Each record represents aggregated performance data for a specific sale over a defined period, providing insights into conversion rates, revenue generation, and customer interaction patterns.

Performance metrics are calculated based on customer interactions, purchases, and engagement activities associated with the sale. This data supports seller analytics, platform optimization, and business intelligence reporting.

The metrics include view counts, conversion rates, revenue totals, and engagement scores that help sellers understand how their sales listings perform in the marketplace.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sale_id

plainFields.name: purchase_count

plainFields.name: period_end

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: ecommerce_mall_carts
models.description:
Main shopping cart container managing customer-specific cart sessions and metadata.

Each cart represents a unique shopping session for a customer, allowing them to add products to their cart temporarily before committing to a purchase. Carts can be active for in-progress shopping sessions or abandoned if left inactive.

The cart maintains association with a specific customer through foreign key reference to enable cart persistence across browser sessions and devices. Customers can have multiple carts over time, with typically one active cart per shopping session.

Cart status tracking supports business analytics for cart abandonment rates and shopping behavior analysis. Soft deletion enables cart preservation for analytical purposes while respecting customer data privacy.

All cart modifications are tracked through the cart snapshots table to maintain audit trail compliance with the platform's snapshot architecture principle.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this shopping cart. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the shopping cart: 'active' for in-progress carts, 'abandoned' for inactive carts.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was soft-deleted for analytics preservation.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_cart_items
models.description:
Individual line items within shopping carts representing specific product variant selections with quantity tracking.

Each cart item captures a customer's selection of a particular product variant within their shopping session. Items maintain the selected variant, quantity, and pricing information as it existed when added to the cart to prevent price changes during the shopping session.

The cart item structure separates individual product selections from the overall cart container, allowing customers to manage multiple items independently while preserving the cart's integrity through the shopping process.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: References the parent shopping cart container that owns this line item. {@link ecommerce_mall_carts.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: References the selected product variant that this cart item represents. {@link ecommerce_mall_product_variants.id}

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of this specific product variant selected in the cart. Mutable field that can be modified during the shopping session.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the variant price at the time the item was added to the cart. Preserves pricing integrity during the shopping session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart item was initially added to the shopping cart.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart item quantity or selection was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart item was removed from the shopping cart. Supports soft deletion for cart management.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_cart_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable snapshots of cart state preserving complete cart information at specific points in time.

Captures the entire cart state including customer information, cart metadata, and all items for audit trail purposes and abandoned cart analysis. Each snapshot represents a frozen state of the cart that cannot be modified, supporting the platform's snapshot principle where all data modifications create immutable records.

Used for analyzing customer behavior, recovering abandoned carts, and maintaining audit trails of cart modifications over time. Snapshots are created automatically when significant cart changes occur or at regular intervals for abandoned cart tracking.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the original cart that this snapshot captures. {@link ecommerce_mall_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owned the cart at snapshot time. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: snapshot_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for creating this snapshot, such as 'cart_abandoned', 'before_checkout', 'periodic_backup', or 'cart_modified'.

plainFields.name: total_items
plainFields.description: Total number of items in the cart at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: total_value
plainFields.description: Total monetary value of all items in the cart at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_cart_snapshot_items
models.description:
Individual items captured within cart snapshots, preserving the specific product variant selections and quantities.

Each record represents a single item that was present in the cart at the time the snapshot was created. This child table decomposes the repeating group of cart items from the main snapshot table, enforcing First Normal Form (1NF) by storing each item separately with its complete state including variant information, quantity, and pricing.

Used for detailed analysis of cart contents, abandoned item tracking, and understanding customer shopping patterns at the individual item level.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_cart_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent cart snapshot containing this item. {@link ecommerce_mall_cart_snapshots.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant that was selected in the cart at snapshot time. {@link ecommerce_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of this specific product variant selected in the cart at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Price per unit of the product variant at the time the snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: total_price
plainFields.description: Total price for this item (quantity × unit_price) at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot item was created (matches parent snapshot timestamp).

models.name: ecommerce_mall_orders
models.description:
Main order records containing customer information, shipping address, payment details, and overall order status.

Represents completed purchases that require fulfillment and tracking. Each order is associated with a specific customer and contains shipping information for delivery. Orders aggregate multiple order items from potentially different sellers into a single transaction.

The order status tracks the overall progression from creation through payment processing, fulfillment, and delivery completion. Orders maintain financial information including subtotal, shipping costs, tax calculations, and final total amounts.

Soft deletion is supported to maintain order history while allowing for customer service operations. All order modifications are tracked through temporal fields for audit purposes.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who placed the order. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Unique order identifier displayed to customers for reference and tracking purposes.

plainFields.name: shipping_address_line1
plainFields.description: Primary street address line for order delivery.

plainFields.name: shipping_address_line2
plainFields.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, or unit number.

plainFields.name: shipping_city
plainFields.description: City for order delivery address.

plainFields.name: shipping_state
plainFields.description: State or province for order delivery address.

plainFields.name: shipping_postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal code or ZIP code for order delivery address.

plainFields.name: shipping_country
plainFields.description: Country for order delivery address.

plainFields.name: subtotal_amount
plainFields.description: Total cost of all order items before taxes and shipping.

plainFields.name: shipping_amount
plainFields.description: Total shipping cost for the entire order.

plainFields.name: tax_amount

plainFields.name: total_amount

plainFields.name: status

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was soft deleted, or null if active.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_order_items
models.description:
Individual items within orders with product/variant snapshots, seller information, and independent status tracking.

Each order item represents a specific product variant purchased by a customer, with its own quantity, pricing, and status independent of the overall order. Items can have different fulfillment statuses even within the same order, supporting multi-seller scenarios where different sellers fulfill different items.

The table maintains references to immutable snapshots of product and variant information at the time of purchase, ensuring data integrity for historical accuracy. Each item tracks its seller relationship and supports independent status progression through the fulfillment lifecycle.

Order items are managed independently from the parent order, allowing for individual cancellation, refund, and status updates while maintaining the overall order context.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Parent order that contains this item. {@link ecommerce_mall_orders.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_id

plainFields.name: quantity

plainFields.name: unit_price

plainFields.name: total_price
plainFields.description: Calculated total price (quantity × unit_price) for this order item.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of this order item (pending, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded).

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item was soft deleted, null if active.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_order_item_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable snapshots preserving the complete state of order items at the time of purchase for audit trails and dispute resolution.

Captures all product, variant, and seller information exactly as it existed when the customer completed their purchase, including product details, pricing, variant options, and seller information. This ensures that any subsequent changes to products, variants, or seller profiles do not affect the historical record of what was actually purchased.

Each snapshot is linked to a specific order item and contains the complete purchase context needed for accurate order history, customer service inquiries, and potential disputes. The snapshot system guarantees data integrity by preventing retroactive modifications to purchase records.

Snapshots are created automatically during order creation and are never modified, serving as an append-only historical record that maintains the integrity of the transactional data.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Order item being snapshotted. {@link ecommerce_mall_order_items.id}

plainFields.name: product_name

plainFields.name: product_description

plainFields.name: variant_name

plainFields.name: unit_price
